properties.name: Shivaram Karanth Layout, east block
properties.text: A second block of the same layout. Fields gave way to a road grid in 2024.

properties.name: Channasandra
properties.text: A green block scraped between 2023 and 2026.

properties.name: Bhaktarahalli
properties.text: Fields turned into sheds and buildings from 2022.

properties.name: Ramapura
properties.text: Buildings spreading across farmland year after year.

properties.name: Varthur
properties.text: Land beside Varthur Lake and the green valley west of its wetland cleared for building from 2023.

properties.name: Panathur and the Varthur shore
properties.text: Green plots inside the village and along the lake shore built over, year after year since 2020.

properties.name: Gudimavu
properties.text: Plantation rows and fields cleared at the centre by 2026.

properties.name: Shivaram Karanth Layout
properties.text: Farmland and scrub scraped for a new layout's road grid in 2024 and 2025.
properties.fact: The biggest single place on the map: 9 of the 30 confirmed losses, side by side.

properties.name: Kolathuru
properties.text: Farmland cut by the new ring highway in 2022, then a large warehouse in 2024.

properties.name: Gattahalli
properties.text: Fields south of Gattahalli Lake built on between 2024 and 2026.

properties.name: K Dommasandra and Kumbena Agrahara
properties.text: Fields and a green wetland valley scraped and built on from 2023.

properties.name: Mutsandra
properties.text: Farmland turned into a construction site from 2022.

properties.name: Tagachaguppe
properties.text: The northern half built as a layout from 2021.

properties.name: Hirandahalli
properties.text: Fields and wetland edges cleared in 2025 and 2026.

properties.name: Medi Agrahara Lake
properties.text: A layout's road grid built right up to the shore in 2024.

properties.name: Chittekarepalya Lake
properties.text: Sheds built on the south edge, within 30 m of the water, in 2025 and 2026.

properties.name: Thubarahalli Lake
properties.text: Towers built on the east edge, within 30 m of the water, by 2022.

properties.name: Lake at Guni Agrahara
properties.text: A layout road laid along the lake's west edge, and the land around it scraped from 2024.

properties.name: Bylakere Lake
properties.text: Layout roads and plots laid around the lake between 2020 and 2023.

properties.name: Yarandahalli Kere
properties.text: The tank bed scraped in 2023, and a building on the north-east edge by 2025.

properties.name: Lake at Dooravaninagar
properties.text: A road widened on its west side and rail works along its south edge, 2024 to 2026.

properties.name: Lake at Mallapura, Nelamangala
properties.text: A polyhouse and a building on the south-east edge in 2025 and 2026.
